branding.book_title: The Mathematics of Artificial Intelligence Agents
branding.author: Jason Karpeles
branding.series_line: The Mathematics of Artificial Intelligence Agents, laboratory reader
branding.index_lead: A Readable Guide to Decisions, Planning, Memory, Tools, Learning, and Cooperation. Each chapter has four illustrated demonstrations drawn from its equations. Choose a value, watch the figure and the numbers change, and check a prediction before reading the answer.
branding.constructed_notice: Each demonstration declares its evidence and input sources. Most use constructed teaching inputs. Where a figure reuses source-reported measurements, its provenance identifies them; selectable controls and illustrative comparisons do not establish results for a deployed agent.
branding.footer_note: A figure illustrates what follows from its declared inputs and assumptions. Its provenance distinguishes constructed examples from source-reported measurements; neither establishes a result for an unevaluated system.
